label: Sam Houser starts at BMG
detail: He begins sorting mail at BMG Records in London, aged 19.

label: Sam Houser heads development at BMG Interactive
detail: Two years after moving to BMG's interactive division.

label: GTA ships with seven radio stations
detail: All original DMA Design music under invented band names, no DJs.

label: Radio goes into the cars
detail: Colin Anderson splits Craig Conner's demos into seven genre stations; DJ and ad ideas are held back by memory and budget.

label: Grand Theft Auto ships with seven radio stations
detail: All original music by DMA Design's musicians; no DJs or ads yet.

label: GTA 1 ships with in-house music
detail: Seven stations of original music by DMA Design's own musicians, credited to fictional acts.

label: Take-Two announces BMG Interactive deal
detail: Take-Two pays about 1.85 million of its shares.

label: CircoLoco starts at DC10
detail: Antonio Carbonaro and Andrea Pelino create the Monday party at DC10 in Ibiza.

label: First Rockstar Loft club night
detail: Chelsea, New York, with Andi Hanley, Bob Sinclar and Dimitri from Paris.

label: GTA III adds talk radio
detail: Lazlow hosts Chatterbox FM; licensed stations run beside in-house Head Radio and Lips 106.

label: Houser and Lazlow write GTA III's radio
detail: Lazlow's company is hired; the pair write the ads, which Lazlow produces from his home studio.

label: GTA III adds talk radio
detail: Dan Houser and Lazlow Jones treat talk radio as cheap filler; Lazlow co-writes the radio.

label: GTA III ships with Chatterbox FM
detail: Lazlow's call-in show, recorded in his home studio with friends, neighbors and his father as callers.

label: Love Fist on V-Rock
detail: Vice City adds the fictional band Love Fist, with Lazlow as V-Rock's head DJ.

label: Vice City adds K-Chat and VCPR
detail: Two talk stations: Amy Sheckenhausen's celebrity interviews and Maurice Chavez's Pressing Issues.

label: Vice City box set released
detail: Seven CDs on Epic Records, one per music station, released internationally.

label: Vice City PC and Xbox ports ship without one song
detail: Lionel Richie's "Running with the Night" was only in the PS2 original, though some accounts date its loss to 2012.

label: Manhunt's original music
detail: Craig Conner writes the score, mostly on a Korg Mono/Poly.

label: Vice City Greatest Hits
detail: A single-disc compilation follows the box set.

label: Celebrities voice San Andreas DJs
detail: Axl Rose, Chuck D and George Clinton voice invented DJs on K-DST, Playback FM and Bounce FM.

label: Ivan Pavlovich joins Rockstar
detail: Later Director of Music; previously founded Guidance Recordings in Chicago.

label: San Andreas: 11 stations mastered as one set
detail: Craig Conner masters 11 stations, 155 tracks and 70 commercials.

label: Wil Wheaton records Richard Burns
detail: Wheaton spends most of an afternoon in summer 2004 voicing the WCTR News reporter.

label: Wil Wheaton confirms WCTR role
detail: Wheaton writes that he voices Richard Burns on San Andreas' WCTR News.

label: San Andreas ships with WCTR
detail: A full talk schedule including Entertaining America, Area 53 and Gardening with Maurice.

label: San Andreas Official Soundtrack
detail: Interscope releases two CDs plus a DVD with the machinima short The Introduction.

label: San Andreas eight-disc box set
detail: One volume per station; SF-UR and WCTR left out. Gameswelt reported December 6 for Europe.

label: Liberty City Stories: LCFR
detail: Five shows, with Chatterbox as one slot and Richard Burns calling Electron Zone Radio.

label: Liberty City Stories radio revealed
detail: Full station list and DJ voices published ahead of release, including DJ Clue on The Liberty Jam.

label: Vice City Stories: VCPR returns
detail: Pressing Issues, Bait and Switch, New World Order and two archive reruns.

label: Vice City Stories characters revealed
detail: Lazlow is the only confirmed voice talent at the reveal.

label: Phil Collins in Vice City Stories
detail: The first real celebrity to appear as himself in a GTA game, per Guinness; an in-game concert, not a radio show.

label: Vice City Stories soundtrack on Urge
detail: Eight music stations, over 100 tracks, sold exclusively as downloads on Urge.

label: Vice City Stories stations on iTunes
detail: All eight music stations arrive on the US iTunes store as an iMix.

label: WKTTRadio.com fan call-in line opens
detail: Fans leave messages on a New York number; some end up on The Richard Bastion Show.

label: GTA IV ships with WKTT, PLR and Integrity 2.0
detail: Three talk stations: right-wing, public radio, and Lazlow's looping street interviews.

label: Reactive DJs and mission bulletins
detail: Rockstar's audio team says GTA IV DJs react to time, weather and events, and Weazel News updates through the story.

label: GTA IV soundtrack supervisors named
detail: Ivan Pavlovich and Andi Hanley source a contemporary Liberty City sound.

label: The Music of Grand Theft Auto IV released
detail: Rockstar's official GTA IV album; the game has 19 stations, 20 on PC.

label: Episodes from Liberty City add talk shows
detail: The Martin Serious Show, Conspire, and Integrity 2.0 with Jorge.

label: The Lost and Damned radio detailed
detail: New shows from Funkmaster Flex, Statik Selektah and Max Cavalera on existing GTA IV stations.

label: Chinatown Wars soundtrack details
detail: Producers Deadmau5, Truth & Soul, Ticklah, Prairie Cartel and Alchemist named for the DS game.

label: Red Dead Redemption soundtrack released
detail: Digital release of the album built around Bill Elm and Woody Jackson's score.

label: Kavinsky station rumor
detail: Kavinsky was rumored to host Nightride FM, a planned GTA V station that never appeared.

label: Max Payne 3 soundtrack by HEALTH
detail: Digital release, after the single "Tears" at the May 15 console launch.

label: Vice City PC pulled from digital stores
detail: Rockstar cited "music licensing issues"; a Michael Jackson track was the reported trigger.

label: Vice City back on Steam, minus nearly 10 songs
detail: Both Michael Jackson songs, Ozzy Osbourne, Kate Bush, Herbie Hancock, Afrika Bambaataa and others gone.

label: GTA V introduces the radio wheel
detail: The radial station picker replaces the old linear selector.

label: GTA V's first full original score
detail: Tangerine Dream, Woody Jackson, The Alchemist and Oh No on an interactive stem system.

label: GTA V soundtrack detailed
detail: 240 licensed songs on 15 music and two talk stations, per Pavlovich.

label: GTA V launches with 15 music stations
detail: 240 licensed songs plus two talk stations, per Ivan Pavlovich.

label: GTA V ships with WCTR and Blaine County Radio
detail: Chakra Attack, Chattersphere and The Fernando Show in Los Santos; three conservative shows in Blaine County.

label: GTA V next-gen edition adds about 165 tracks
detail: Spread across 13 stations, including 22 songs cut from the 2013 release.

label: Froese's Cinematographic Score
detail: Edgar Froese releases 12 tracks of GTA V material, limited to 2,000 copies.

label: San Andreas Steam update cuts 17 songs
detail: The PC version was made to match the mobile version, which had already lost the same 17.

label: GTA V on PC: Self Radio and The Lab
detail: Self Radio debuts with the PC version. The Lab reached consoles July 8, 2015; its debut month is disputed.

label: blonded Los Santos 97.8 FM
detail: Frank Ocean's station arrives with the Doomsday Heist, the first new station in over two years.

label: blonded Los Santos 97.8 FM
detail: The Doomsday Heist adds Frank Ocean's station, hosted by his blonded RADIO co-hosts.

label: J.B. Smoove on Chakra Attack
detail: Smoove tells PC Gamer the show was scripted but he was given room to play.

label: GTA IV update removes 43 to 51 songs
detail: The count depends on whether episode tracks are included; Vladivostok FM lost 15 and gained 11 replacements.

label: GTA IV loses licensed songs
detail: Expired licenses remove songs from GTA IV and its episodes, many from Vladivostok FM.

label: Nightclub residents on the radio
detail: After Hours puts four resident DJs' mixes on Los Santos Underground Radio, unlocked through setup missions.

label: Los Santos Underground Radio
detail: After Hours adds a station of resident DJ mixes, starting with Solomun.

label: After Hours nightclubs
detail: Players can own nightclubs with resident DJs Solomun, Tale Of Us, Dixon and The Black Madonna.

label: Tale Of Us residency
detail: Tale Of Us join Los Santos Underground Radio, debuting tracks from Afterlight.

label: First virtual club livestream
detail: Tale Of Us play a 30-minute set from a virtual Los Santos club, streamed on Resident Advisor's Facebook.

label: RDR2 collaborators detailed
detail: Rockstar's breakdown credits Woody Jackson, Daniel Lanois and a roster of additional scorers.

label: RDR2 score album
detail: Woody Jackson's score released digitally, a month after the vocal album.

label: CircoLoco and Rockstar in Miami
detail: A joint event in Miami that Carbonaro names as the seed of the label.

label: iFruit Radio
detail: Danny Brown's station arrives with the Diamond Casino Heist.

label: iFruit Radio
detail: The Diamond Casino Heist adds Danny Brown's station.

label: Lazlow leaves Rockstar
detail: After nearly 20 years. The month is usually given as April, though the first report of his exit is dated August 2020.

label: Lazlow leaves Rockstar
detail: After nine GTA games he joins Dan Houser at Absurd Ventures.

label: Dan Houser's last day at Rockstar
detail: The date comes from a Take-Two SEC filing, reported February 4, 2020.

label: Lazlow leaves Rockstar
detail: A month after Dan Houser, by PC Gamer's dating. VGC did not report the exit until August 14, 2020, from his LinkedIn.

label: Lazlow Jones's exit reported
detail: VGC reports it from his LinkedIn; other accounts put his exit in April 2020.

label: Kult FM's absent host
detail: Cayo Perico adds Kult FM, where Julian Casablancas never reaches the booth and producer Zachary (David Cross) fills in.

label: Cayo Perico Heist music update
detail: Kult FM, Still Slipping Los Santos and The Music Locker, with over 250 new tracks by Rockstar's count.

label: The Cayo Perico Heist
detail: The Music Locker opens with Moodymann, Keinemusik and Palms Trax; Still Slipping and Kult FM launch.

label: CircoLoco Records announced
detail: Rockstar Games and CircoLoco announce a co-owned label.

label: CircoLoco Records announced
detail: CircoLoco and Rockstar Games announce a joint venture label.

label: Monday Dreamin' Blue EP
detail: The label's first release, led by Seth Troxler's "Lumartes".

label: Monday Dreamin' album
detail: The full 20-track compilation is released.

label: CircoLoco sticks in GTA Online
detail: Los Santos Tuners adds the Media Player, four Monday Dreamin' EP sticks and Seth Troxler's CLR Launch Party mix.

label: Kano leaves GTA V's Space 103.2 (disputed date)
detail: The fan wiki dates the removal to the Los Santos Tuners update; LevelUp says 2018.

label: Media Player
detail: Los Santos Tuners adds a station for collected Media Sticks.

label: Los Santos Tuners and the Media Player
detail: Media sticks arrive, with Moodymann as Kenny and four hidden CircoLoco EP sticks.

label: Trilogy Definitive Edition launch list missing 38 songs
detail: VGC counted 20 missing from Vice City and 18 from San Andreas.

label: Rockstar reinstates 17 Trilogy tracks
detail: 14 on Vice City and three on San Andreas; Michael Jackson and Rage Against the Machine stay out.

label: Dr. Dre tracks tied to The Contract
detail: Six new Dr. Dre tracks join Radio Los Santos alongside The Contract's missions.

label: MOTOMAMI Los Santos and the Dr. Dre update
detail: The Contract adds Rosalía and Arca's station and reworks Radio Los Santos.

label: The Contract
detail: Six new Dr. Dre tracks premiere in-game; MOTOMAMI Los Santos and the Dre Day takeover launch.

label: Dre's Contract songs reach streaming
detail: The six tracks hit streaming services ahead of the Super Bowl halftime show.

label: NEZ EP (CLR 002)
detail: Tracks first heard in GTA Online, including ScHoolboy Q's feature, reach streaming.

label: Monday Dreamin' vinyl box
detail: A five-LP box set of the compilation.

label: Los Santos Drug Wars score
detail: A seven-track adaptive score by Soulwax and Nick Hook.

label: Drug Wars adaptive score
detail: Seven tracks by Soulwax and Nick Hook, each built from four to eight stems.

label: Trailer 1 posted early
detail: Released a day ahead of plan after leaking; Tom Petty's 'Love Is a Long Road'; a 2025 window.

label: DāM-FunK score on streaming
detail: DāM-FunK Presents The Music of Grand Theft Auto Online (Original Score) is released, 15 tracks.

label: GTA Online score album
detail: DāM-FunK Presents The Music of Grand Theft Auto Online (Original Score), 15 tracks, reaches streaming.

label: Prospa's first CircoLoco single
detail: "If You Want My Loving" (CRL 010) begins Prospa's run as the label's most frequent act.

label: Heaven 17's Martyn Ware describes a $7,500 GTA VI offer
detail: A perpetual buyout, by his account; he turned it down.

label: Prospa "Don't Stop" (CLR015)
detail: Single built on a hook from Somethin' For The People's 1997 "My Love Is the Shhh!".

label: Trailer 2 released
detail: Set to The Pointer Sisters' 'Hot Together'; over 475 million first-day views per Rockstar.

label: Lazlow doubts he will be in GTA VI
detail: He says so in a Nerd Reactor interview.

label: Houser explains why GTA has talk radio
detail: Talking to IGN, he says talk was the cheap way to fill hours of driving.

label: Delay to November 19, 2026
detail: Rockstar moved GTA VI from May 26, 2026 to November 19, 2026.

label: Jamback "Positive"
detail: Jamback's label debut, later reported by Beatport as its longest-running No. 1 at 64 days.

label: Beatport Label of the Month
detail: Beatport names CircoLoco Records Label of the Month and reports the "Positive" record.

label: Prospa, Free Your Mind
detail: Prospa's debut album on the label, vinyl CLR019V, with the title track featuring Cloonee.

label: Lazlow on his character
detail: Lazlow says Houser made the in-game Lazlow worse each game.

label: Extended Look and a station leak
detail: The 26-minute Netflix preview premieres; separately, leaked footage reported by Netzwelt shows 14 station names.

label: LEAK: CircoLoco Records Radio
detail: We Rave You reports an unconfirmed clip from a claimed GTA VI build showing the station name.

label: GTA V Enhanced hotfix removes Moloko
detail: "The Time Is Now" leaves Non-Stop-Pop FM on PC; no Rockstar statement.

label: Moloko song pulled from Non-Stop-Pop FM (reported)
detail: Reported for GTA V Enhanced on PC; consoles not confirmed and no reason given by Rockstar.

label: The Album announced
detail: Rockstar and Atlantic announce 34 tracks and six singles; the liquid vinyl sells out on the UK store within minutes.

label: GTA VI stations revealed
detail: Rockstar names its first six stations. None of them is CircoLoco's.

label: GTA VI talk radio and podcasts
detail: Rockstar previews six stations and confirms talk radio plus character podcasts for Jason and Lucia.

label: First six radio stations named
detail: Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics, with hosts including Bad Bunny and Lana Del Rey.

label: GTA VI talk radio confirmed
detail: Rockstar's radio preview confirms talk radio and on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia.

label: Justice named GTA VI composers
detail: Announced alongside the Launch Trailer.

label: Launch Trailer and Justice score
detail: Justice's 'Flower in a Hurricane' with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard; Justice named score composers.

label: Justice named as GTA VI composers
detail: Original-score song Pusher released; 30-track score album due December 11, 2026.

label: "Pusher" from the GTA VI score
detail: Justice release a song from the original score; a 30-track score album is due December 11, 2026.

label: Sensor Tower pre-order estimate
detail: About 7.71 million digital pre-orders and $751 million, an estimate, not company data.

label: Take-Two: GTA V at nearly 235 million units
detail: Official sold-in figure for the quarter to September 30, 2026.

label: Take-Two reiterates the date
detail: Fiscal Q2 results kept November 19 and called pre-orders 'unprecedented', with no unit figures.

label: Full album tracklist leaks
detail: A 34-track list shared on X, leaker unnamed, reported by Omelete; unconfirmed by Rockstar or Atlantic.

label: GTA VI and The Album release
detail: Scheduled launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with the album the same day; physical editions ship November 20.
